items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: You know Morey Amsterdam and you know like they know a million jokes. So I’m not going to tell you — here’s the framework.

ctx.x: Yeah. I could write those routines for these people because I’d write frameworks, because all these people were great. You know and I’d say I’m not going to tell you what to say, you know I’m going to do this. You know Morey Amsterdam and you know like they know a million jokes. So I’m not going to tell you — here’s the framework. We do this and from here you go outside, just remember the ending is when I drop the glass on the floor and you say this and then we go to commercial. And it worked great. We did 50…
Do you ever get residuals or anything like that?
